name: Drift Scoring
description: Converts sustained slides into bankable style points. It owns the judgement of what counts as a drift — minimum slip angle, minimum speed, minimum hold time — and the multiplier that grows while the slide is held, because the tension of a drift game is that the score exists only as long as the risk does. Banking and losing are tied to the track's own events: points bank when world.checkpointCrossed confirms the car survived to a gate, and the live stake drops on world.lapInvalidated, so cutting the corner to save a drift never pays. It reads slip from the vehicle produced by movement.vehicle_basic's motion and movement.vehicle_tuning's grip, but owns neither. It also does not post scores anywhere — social.leaderboard and ui.hud are the sinks for progression.driftBanked.

inputs.name: minSlipAngleDeg
inputs.description: Slip angle below which the car is cornering, not drifting. Set just above what good grip driving produces, or every fast corner scores.

inputs.name: minSpeed
inputs.description: Speed floor for scoring. Prevents farming points with slow donuts in a car park.

inputs.name: minHoldSeconds
inputs.description: How long the slip must be sustained before progression.driftStarted fires. Filters out incidental twitches on landing or bump.

inputs.name: multiplierPerSecond
inputs.description: Growth rate of the live multiplier while the drift holds, capped by maxMultiplier.

inputs.name: maxMultiplier
inputs.description: Cap on the live multiplier. The cap is the risk ceiling: the longer the slide, the more there is to lose on lapInvalidated.

outputs.name: activeDriftScore
outputs.description: Unbanked points riding on the current drift. Zero whenever no drift is live.

outputs.name: bankedTotal
outputs.description: Points safely banked this race. Only this figure should ever reach a leaderboard.
